# `github_issue`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] github_issue`

Manage GitHub issues: create, list, view, close, reopen, or comment on issues.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `create`, `list`, `view`, `close`, `reopen`, `comment` | yes | Action to perform on GitHub issues |
| `body` | string | no | Issue body or comment body |
| `issue_number` | integer | no | Issue number (required for view, close, reopen, comment) |
| `labels` | array of string | no | Labels to apply (for 'create' action) |
| `owner` | string | yes | Repository owner (username or organization) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Results per page (for 'list' action, default: 30, max: 100) |
| `repo` | string | yes | Repository name |
| `state` | one of `open`, `closed`, `all` | no | Filter by state (for 'list' action, default: open) |
| `title` | string | no | Issue title (required for 'create') |
| `token` | string | no | GitHub token (optional). Falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, `gh auth login`, gh hosts.yml, or git credentials. |
